subject: [AMBER] Compatibility of NVIDIA RTX 5060/5070/4060/4080 GPUs with Amber installation

messages.author: Abhisek Jana
messages.body:
Dear all,
We are planning to set up a workstation for running Amber with GPU
acceleration and would like to clarify the compatibility of some NVIDIA
GPUs. Specifically, I want to know if Amber (CUDA version) is currently
compatible with the following GPUs:
*
NVIDIA RTX 5060
*
NVIDIA RTX 5070
*
NVIDIA RTX 4060
*
NVIDIA RTX 4080
If anyone has experience running Amber on these GPUs, I would greatly
appreciate your feedback regarding installation, CUDA compatibility, and
performance stability. Additionally, any recommendations on which of
these GPUs would be most suitable for Amber simulations would be very
helpful.
Abhisek Jana
IPDF Fellow
Department of Chemistry
IIT Bombay

messages.author: Maria Nagan
messages.body:
Hi,
Please see
https://ambermd.org/GPUHardware.php
. Suitability of the GPU type depends on what you want to do, how much you want to spend and availability of the GPU. As far as cuda versions go, make sure your operating system, cuda version and drivers are all compatible (check NVIDIA site for full details).
Maria
